en: Thick wheat noodles kept warm under a cheap heat lamp — the most reliably comforting thing in the pantry.

Fermented chilies pounded down with citrus peel — a fresh, sharp heat for anyone chasing something adventurous.
Something hearty and savory, please — I've been rewiring solar panels on the north tower all shift and I want to feel human again.
